description: Self-contained callout block: emoji icon (with picker) + contenteditable body. Owns its JS keyboard-handler lifecycle, identical to TmNotionTextBlock pattern. [JSInvokable] names must match notion-editor.js; EventCallback names are distinct to avoid C# property/method conflicts.

parameters.name: OnContentSaved
parameters.description: Fired on blur when the HTML has changed. Arg = new HTML.

parameters.name: OnDeleteRequested
parameters.description: Fired when Backspace is pressed on an empty block.

parameters.name: OnMergeWithPrevious
parameters.description: Raised when Backspace is pressed at the start of a non-empty block. The payload is the block's current, sanitized HTML, which the previous block absorbs before this one is deleted.

parameters.name: OnStructuredPaste
parameters.description: Raised when pasted HTML carries more than one block element. The payload is the raw clipboard HTML; the consumer turns it into page blocks.

parameters.name: OnEmojiChanged
parameters.description: Fired when the emoji icon is changed or removed. Arg = new emoji string, or null when the user removes the icon.

parameters.name: OnEnterSplit
parameters.description: Fired after Enter splits the block. Arg = HTML fragment after the split point.

parameters.name: OnFocused
parameters.description: Fired when the editable body receives focus.

parameters.name: OnIndentChange
parameters.description: Fired when Tab / Shift+Tab is pressed. Bool = shiftKey (true = outdent).

parameters.name: OnMentionMenu
parameters.description: Fired when '@' mention syntax is typed. Args = (top, left) caret coords.

parameters.name: OnPageLinkMenu
parameters.description: Fired when '[[' page-link syntax is typed. Args = (top, left) caret coords.

parameters.name: OnSlashMenu
parameters.description: Fired when '/' is typed in a trigger position. Args = (top, left) caret coords.

parameters.name: OnTokenMenu
parameters.description: Fired when '{{' token syntax is typed. Args = (top, left) caret coords.

parameters.name: OnTypeConvert
parameters.description: Fired when a markdown pattern is recognised. Arg = shortcut key.
